questions.question: What is the function of the Motherboard on the computer?
options: Scanner and other things are part of the motherboard.
A circuit board that connects all the external and internal hardware.
It is a type of file server.
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is  A circuit board that connects all the external and internal hardware . Key Points A circuit board that connects all the external and internal hardware  is the function of the Motherboard on the computer   ​ It is also called a system board . It is the main printed circuit board (PCB) in general-purpose computers. questions.question:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are true about programming languages?

(i) Assembly language is machine independent.

(ii) Python is a low-level programming language.
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is  Neither (i) nor (ii) . Key Points Assembly Language An assembly language is a type of l ow-level programming language that is intended to c ommunicate directly with a computer's hardware . questions.question: The first generation computers can be characterized as _______.
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is Digital computer Key Points In computing technology generation , the first era was from 1946 to 1959 . The first generation of computers used vacuum tubes for the basic components of memory and the circuitry of the CPU (Central Processing Unit). These tubes, like light bulbs, produced a lot of heat and frequently melted equipment. They were therefore very expensive and only large organisations could afford them. questions.question: Which of the following is the smallest unit of storage?
questions.solution: Solution: The correct answer is KB . Key Points KB stands for kilobyte which is the smallest unit of storage among the given options.  Unit Description Kilobyte (KB) 1 KB = 1024 Bytes Megabyte (MB) 1 MB = 1024 KB GigaByte (GB) 1 GB = 1024 MB TeraByte (TB) 1 TB = 1024 GB PetaByte (PB) 1 PB = 1024 TB A memory unit is the amount of data that can be stored in the storage unit.
